catalogue_definition.evacuation: every user on each active beam to best live legal alternative
catalogue_definition.s0: top-two nominal proposals plus frozen beam evacuations
catalogue_definition.unilateral: every live legal move for every user
catalogue_definition.zero_legal_user: explicit null action; excluded from Cartesian factor

catalogue_scope: stage-4b bounded catalogue with complete Cartesian cells up to the sealed limit

definitions.nearest-eligible: minimum slant among visible D2-eligible physical candidates; physical-ID tie
definitions.random-masked: uniform index from a SHA-256 world/step/user key over sorted legal identities
definitions.stay-if-possible: retain incumbent physical identity while legal, else nearest-eligible
